definitions.explanation: A person who belongs to a group, team, or organization.

examples.japanese: チームのメンバーは{五人|ごにん}だ。
{新|あたら}しいメンバーが{加|くわ}わった。
メンバー{全員|ぜんいん}で{話|はな}し{合|あ}った。
examples.english: We discussed it with all the members.

notes:
メンバー is commonly used for group members in various contexts.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- メンバー{全員|ぜんいん}: all members
- メンバーになる: to become a member
- メンバーを{集|あつ}める: to gather members
- メンバー{紹介|しょうかい}: member introduction
- メンバー{構成|こうせい}: member composition
- メンバーズカード: membership card

RELATED WORDS:
- {会員|かいいん}: member (of an organization)
- {仲間|なかま}: companion, fellow member
- {一員|いちいん}: a member (of a group)

[Register: Neutral]
